Poland activates air defences as Russian drone violates its airspace during attack on Ukraine | Ukrainska Pravda
Stock photo: Getty Images
Poland has activated its air defence forces on the night of 24 November in response to a Russian attack on Ukraine.
Source: Operational Command of the Polish Armed Forces on X (Twitter)
Quote: "In connection with strikes carried out by the Russian Federation against targets on Ukrainian territory using aerial weapons, the appropriate forces and assets of Poland's air defence system have been activated."
Advertisement:





Details: The command noted that these measures are precautionary and aimed at protecting Polish airspace, particularly in areas bordering those under threat.
The command added that it is continuously monitoring the situation and that forces under its command are ready to respond immediately.
Update: The command later added that a Russian drone had violated Polish airspace during the attack on Ukraine's west. However, the Polish military did not open fire, saying that doing so could have posed a threat to civilians.

Russian intelligence services planned a sabotage operation on Polish territory for late October or early November, senior sources told the Polish newspaper Rzeczpospolita. The plan could have involved crossing the border and staging an attack on a target inside Poland.
They said the sabotage could have been staged as a “false flag” operation meant to pin the blame on Kyiv.
The warning about the planned sabotage came from intelligence services in partner countries, though analysts at Polish intelligence agencies also raised the possibility of a provocation, the newspaper’s sources said. Hundreds of schools in Germany and Denmark receive bomb threats
November 23, 2026, 10:31 pm
Source: Bloomberg
Schools in Germany and Denmark have received bomb threats. Authorities in both countries are investigating and believe the threats were hoaxes.
In Denmark, the threats were emailed to several schools across the country. Police said they saw no need at this point to evacuate schools or take special security measures.
In Germany, about 450 schools nationwide received threats, including schools in Berlin, Hamburg, Lower Saxony, and Thuringia.
Since mid-October, schools in several European countries, as well as airlines, airports, and media outlets, have received false bomb threats. It remains unclear who sent the messages. The Financial Times reported that European intelligence agencies are looking into whether Russia was involved in sending the threats.

Gunfire accounted for only 1.3% of deaths. Other, even less common causes included coronary heart disease (about 2,000 deaths), suicide (about 1,300), and pneumonia (about 700).

November 23, 2026, 10:58 am
Source: Meduza
The Russian Navy corvette Merkury sank in the Libyan port of Benghazi on November 22 after naval drones struck the warship. An explosion tore through the vessel, igniting a major fire. The corvette went down, leaving only its bow visible above the water.
Drone strike on the Merkury . Video published by the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU)
Volodymyr Zelensky’s Telegram channel
According to sources who spoke to the Al Jazeera television network, the explosion aboard the Merkury killed Russians and Libyans. The network’s sources gave no further details about the casualties and did not specify whether the Libyans who died were aboard the ship or nearby.
The Merkury had been docked in the port of Benghazi for several days before the explosion. It had entered the port to refuel and resupply under a cooperation agreement…

November 23, 2026, 9:23 am
Source: Government of Poland
Debris from X-101 cruise missiles turned up in all three Polish towns where Russian objects fell during the overnight attack on Ukraine on November 20.
Polish military equipment and weapons experts who examined the fragments that fell in the towns of Nowy Lipowiec, Rudnik nad Sanem, and Mołodycz reached that conclusion.
According to preliminary findings, all the missiles were manufactured in the fourth quarter of 2026 at a plant in the city of Dubna, Moscow region, Polish prosecutors said.
NATO will hold an emergency meeting at its headquarters in Brussels on November 23 over the Russian missiles that violated Polish airspace. Poland’s Deputy Defense Minister Paweł Zalewski told Polish Radio that the meeting would discuss ways to strengthen air defense for Poland and NATO’s eastern flank.

In einem Hafen der ostlibyschen Stadt Bengasi hat es eine Explosion auf einem russischen Kriegsschiff gegeben. Die Behörden gehen von einem Angriff mit Drohnen aus. Berichten zufolge wird die Ukraine verantwortlich gemacht.
An einer Marinebasis im östlichen Libyen hat sich auf einem russischen Kriegsschiff eine schwere Explosion ereignet. Die Regierung im Osten des faktisch gespaltenen Landes teilte mit, vermutlich sei das Schiff mit Drohnen angegriffen worden. Die Nachrichtenagentur dpa will aus Kreisen der Militärbasis in Bengasi erfahren haben, sechs ukrainische Drohnenboote hätten das Schiff angegriffen. Ein libyscher Fernsehsender berichtete, vier dieser sechs Drohnenboote seien daraufhin untauglich gemacht worden.
Experten zufolge handelt es sich bei dem Schiff um die Korvette "Merkury" der russischen Marine. Sie sei durch die Explosion höchstwahrscheinlich zerstört worden.

Zásahu předcházelo dvoudenní hašení požáru. Všech 16 členů posádky bylo evakuováno na blízkou ruskou loď, přičemž jeden námořník utrpěl lehké zranění.

Podle finské armády bylo zasaženo v mezinárodních vodách západně od ruského ostrova Hogland (rusky Gogland) pravděpodobně ukrajinskými drony a do finských vod ji následně unesl proud, uvedl Reuters. Finské ozbrojené síly již minulý týden zaznamenaly ve stejné oblasti útok na ruskou válečnou loď.
Termokamery ukazují, že některé kontejnery na palubě jsou stále teplé, plavidlo je ale dostatečně stabilní k zahájení…

titulek: Body of person recovered from under rubble of apartment block in Kyiv Oblast
titulekPuvodni: Body of person recovered from under rubble of apartment block in Kyiv Oblast
shrnuti: Rescue workers have recovered the body of a person killed in the Russian attack on a five-storey apartment block in Dymer. Three people have been injured.

vyrez.text:
Two bodies recovered from under rubble of apartment block in Dymer | Ukrainska Pravda
The destroyed building. Photo: State Emergency Service of Ukraine
Two bodies have been recovered from under the rubble of a five-storey apartment building in Dymer, Kyiv Oblast, which was damaged in a Russian attack. The number injured has risen to four .
Source: Kyiv Oblast Military Administration
Details: The regional authorities said that one of those injured is a woman aged about 54 who was suffering from shock.
Advertisement:





Medics are treating her at the scene, and she does not require hospitalisation.
The search and rescue operation is ongoing.
Update: At around 14:30, Kyiv Oblast Military Administration reported that the death toll from the Russian attack on Dymer had risen to two after rescue workers recovered another body from under the rubble.

Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Photo: Ukraine's President's Office
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said he does not know what exactly partners mean by " NATO Article 5-style " security guarantees, but is certain that Ukraine needs guarantees lasting far longer than Donald Trump's time as US president.
Source: European Pravda, citing Zelenskyy speaking to journalists
Details: First and foremost, security guarantees for Ukraine must be based on concrete proposals rather than on good relations between US President Donald Trump and Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin, Zelenskyy said. Ukraine does not need guarantees solely for the two remaining years of Trump's presidency.

Policisté začali poškození bankomatu v objektu pošty prověřovat už od nočních hodin. Nejprve na síti X uvedli, že pachatelé zařízení poškodili výbušninami a odcizili finanční hotovost, jejíž přesná výše tehdy ještě nebyla upřesněna.
Nyní kriminalisté potvrdili, že odcizená hotovost přesahuje milion korun. Podle policejní mluvčí Moniky Kozumplíkové se další vyšetřování zaměřuje na širší okolí místa činu i blízkost státní hranice.

By Reuters
Nov. 21, 2026
NICOLAS TUCAT / AFP
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said on Saturday the EU stands in full solidarity with Denmark and strongly condemns an assassination attempt against a U.S.-Ukrainian citizen in Denmark allegedly orchestrated by Russian intelligence services.
"This was an attack on EU soil. And it is unacceptable. We stand in full solidarity with Denmark. And with all Member States targeted by Russian hybrid attacks," she said in an X post.
The Russian embassy in Copenhagen said on Friday the accusations were not backed with proof.
Von der Leyen added that EU will soon propose a "new European Security Strategy" to reinforce preparedness and deterrence.

titulekPuvodni: Energy infrastructure damaged in Russian attack on Vinnytsia, power outages reported
shrnuti: A 50-year-old woman was injured in a Russian attack on Vinnytsia Oblast on 21 November. Residential buildings, a civilian business and energy infrastructure have been damaged. Power outages have been reported in Vinnytsia.

Source : Natalia Zabolotna, Head of Vinnytsia Oblast Military Administration, on Telegram
Details : According to Zabolotna, a 50-year-old woman sustained minor injuries and was taken to hospital.

The attack damaged a civilian business, a vehicle repair workshop and seven vehicles – four cars and three lorries.
Windows were shattered and roofs damaged in around 20 residential buildings.
Zabolotna later reported that an energy infrastructure facility had been damaged in Vinnytsia as a result of the attack. Parts of the city are left without electricity.
